summary: Full test of the new Pharmacy-Initiated Prescription Request workflow (backend + frontend). 15/15 pytest cases pass covering directory search, patient-snapshot, POST /internal/pharmacy-rx (source=pharmacy, waiting_physician, RX-ref, joined medication_name, empty-meds 400, unknown-dir 404), physician queue filter, all physician actions (approve/modify/more_info/decline) + staff complete, staff rx counter (approved-but-not-completed included), and book-appointment from a pharmacy Rx (source rx becomes appointment_booked). Frontend Playwright verified: pharmacy-refill-btn on /internal/rx, SOURCE column with PHARMACY & PATIENT badges, full intake flow with all data-testids (intake-search, intake-search-btn, intake-result, intake-pharmacy, intake-meds, intake-via-fax, intake-send), YYYY Mon - DD date format both in intake-result and snapshot DOB (matched '1958 Apr - 22'), success toast 'Sent to physician Rx queue.' and navigation back to /internal/rx with new PHARMACY row visible. Physician-action testids (act-approve/act-modify/act-appt-req/act-more-info/act-decline in RxQueue.jsx, act-book-appointment in Queue.jsx) verified by code inspection and are exercised by the backend action tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1500 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth/portal/internal/rx) for maintainability.
PharmacyRxBody.received_via accepts any string — consider Literal['fax','phone','other'] for validation.

_update_request applies the approve/modify/more_info/decline branches to ALL request types (imaging/bloodwork/messages) via shared function. Non-Rx entities inheriting 'approved_process_visita' semantics may not fit their status maps (BLD_PATIENT_STATUS/IMG_PATIENT_STATUS have no 'approved_process_visita' key) — patient-visible status would fall back to None. Consider gating these actions to prescriptions.

create_pharmacy_rx uses directory_id or linked_patient_id as patient_id but never verifies linked patient exists; notifications for approve/modify/decline paths call notify_patient with directory_id when unlinked — no matching patient record for the notification recipient.
counters endpoint recomputes 'rx' with RX_ACTIVE which now includes approved_process_visita/more_info_required (correct per requirement) — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (staff flow verified end-to-end; physician action selectors verified in source)
